testCarrier.limitation: source and deterministic model coverage; not simulator A/B switching or runtime race proof

exclusions.reason: QA-only synthetic harness; writes isolated temporary fixtures and a user-invoked evidence report, not production account state

surfaces.dataClass: opaque user access and refresh session credentials
surfaces.ownerScope: verified backend subject plus token family and session version
surfaces.storage: iOS Keychain
surfaces.cleanup: clear on logout, revoke, invalid refresh, owner mismatch, or ineligible contract
surfaces.migration: reject legacy/ineligible writes; do not migrate mobile shared or system tokens
surfaces.retention: until session expiry, revoke, logout, or account deletion

surfaces.dataClass: display-only current user profile cache, replayable account activation phase receipt, and private access state
surfaces.ownerScope: profile must match a validated typed session subject; journal is value-minimized and owner-free
surfaces.storage: standard UserDefaults
surfaces.readers: AccountSessionActor/AppCoordinator composition and private UI display
surfaces.cleanup: quarantine mismatched profile before validation; clear and unmount private state on logout, suspension, or delete
surfaces.migration: global cached user is display data only; valid Keychain session subject may rebuild a placeholder profile after online validation
surfaces.retention: current validated session profile plus latest value-minimized activation phase receipt

surfaces.dataClass: archive drafts, source metadata, time-letter metadata, and local message state
surfaces.ownerScope: archive items use authenticated subject plus vault plus archive owner; mailbox and in-app state remain viewer scoped
surfaces.storage: UserDefaults V2 hashed owner envelope, device-neutral quarantine and migration receipts; viewer-scoped message keys remain transitional
surfaces.readers: Archive UI, Echo context builder, InAppMessageCenter
surfaces.cleanup: unmount on switch; scoped purge on account deletion; message state follows its viewer lifecycle
surfaces.migration: explicit self-owned legacy records may copy-on-write with a receipt; ownerless, ambiguous, corrupt or family legacy without source evidence enters quarantine and is never auto-claimed
surfaces.retention: owner draft policy and sealed time-letter policy
surfaces.testOwner: WI-S0-01-05 for archive envelopes; WI-S0-01-07 for remaining message state

surfaces.dataClass: private photo, audio, video, thumbnail, and time-letter image staging files
surfaces.ownerScope: archive media uses authenticated subject plus vault plus archive owner; Home photos and temporary conversation recordings use authenticated subject plus vault
surfaces.storage: scoped Application Support originals and scoped Caches thumbnails/staging; Home legacy files are quarantined or discarded with durable receipts
surfaces.writer: Archive entry controllers, AIRecordingViewController, and QA fixture paths in AppDelegate
surfaces.readers: MemoryArchiveItem, Archive UI, upload pipeline, Echo context
surfaces.cleanup: remove scoped archive media on item deletion; stale Home staging is discarded on lease change; account-wide scoped purge remains WI-S0-01-08
surfaces.migration: legacy archive files require allowlisted canonical path and verified owner binding; Home Documents/photos are quarantined and temporary TGSessionRecordings are discarded with deterministic receipts
surfaces.retention: draft retention decision DR-041; Home temporary recordings are session-only; quarantined files follow migration retention policy
surfaces.testOwner: WI-S0-01-05 for archive media; WI-S0-01-06 for Home account-private media; WI-S0-01-08 for account-wide purge

surfaces.dataClass: knowledge graph, sync base, pending mutation, governance outbox, sync history, and temporary private exports
surfaces.ownerScope: main stores use owner/persona/generation/epoch; sync_history and temporary exports remain global legacy
surfaces.storage: Documents/Application Support JSON files plus temporary JSON/PDF exports
surfaces.pathOrKey: knowledge_base/kb_graph_<user>.json; kb_sync_base_<digest>.json; kb_pending_mutation_<digest>.json; kb_governance_outbox_<digest>.json; sync_history.json; temporary knowledge/family_book exports
surfaces.readers: KBLite, Knowledge Sync, Echo context, Family projection
surfaces.cleanup: unmount and cancel sync on switch; clear projection on epoch change; delete owner files and shared export artifacts on lifecycle cleanup
surfaces.migration: legacy kb_graph.json is quarantined; global sync_history is not authority; temporary exports require deterministic post-share removal
surfaces.retention: rebuildable projection; pending/outbox until receipt or explicit cleanup

surfaces.dataClass: conversation summaries and extracted local conversation memory
surfaces.ownerScope: authenticated subject plus vault plus persona owner; generation fences async commits without changing the persistent owner key
surfaces.storage: Application Support owner envelope with migration receipt and quarantine directories
surfaces.pathOrKey: DreamJourney/Conversation/v2/<scopeDigest>/memory.json; receipts/<sourceHash>.json; quarantine/<sourceHash>.json; Documents conversation_memory*.json is legacy read-only input
surfaces.cleanup: unmount on login scope change, logout or private-access suspension; purge proven subject/vault envelopes on account deletion
surfaces.migration: explicit personal_<subject> legacy may copy-on-write with receipt; global, family owner-only, fallback-owner and corrupt legacy is quarantined and never auto-mounted
surfaces.retention: conversation cache only; backend Message remains authority

surfaces.dataClass: delayed Echo reply, inbox source projections, unread/read/archive state, and local schedules
surfaces.ownerScope: AccountLease subject, vault, generation, generationId, resource owner and operation; notification metadata carries only digested identities
surfaces.storage: generation-scoped UserDefaults envelopes plus owner-scoped local notification requests
surfaces.pathOrKey: dj.echo.delayedReply.scoped.v2; dj.echo.delayedReply.callsite-scope.v1; dj.inAppMessage.<surface>.sources.v2.<scopeDigest>; generation-scoped time-letter mailbox/local state
surfaces.cleanup: cancel old timer/notification and clear unread projection on switch/logout/delete
surfaces.migration: quarantine legacy global message bodies without auto-claim; rebuild from backend by owner/resource
surfaces.retention: until delivered/read/archive or account lifecycle cleanup

surfaces.dataClass: memoir JSON drafts and source recordings
surfaces.ownerScope: authenticated subject plus vault plus explicit memoir owner; generation fences async commits without changing the persistent owner key
surfaces.storage: Application Support owner envelopes with migration receipts and quarantine directories
surfaces.cleanup: unmount on account generation or owner mismatch; account-wide scoped purge remains WI-S0-01-08
surfaces.migration: copy explicit owner-matching legacy memoirs with receipts; seed, ownerless, mismatched, corrupt and unclaimed recordings enter quarantine and never auto-upload
surfaces.retention: local draft policy DR-041

surfaces.dataClass: legacy memories, seed fixtures, map read state, and transient map presentation timers
surfaces.ownerScope: authenticated subject plus vault plus explicit memory owner; map presentation state uses the same owner envelope
surfaces.storage: owner-scoped UserDefaults envelopes, device quarantine and deterministic migration receipts; presentation timers remain ephemeral
surfaces.cleanup: unmount on owner mismatch and invalidate presentation timers; account-wide scoped purge remains WI-S0-01-08
surfaces.migration: seed fixtures are do-not-migrate; legacy memories and map state enter deterministic quarantine with item-level receipts and are never auto-claimed
surfaces.retention: owner-scoped local projection plus legacy quarantine retention policy

surfaces.dataClass: voice profile id, sample/provider status, consent-derived enablement, and training poll
surfaces.ownerScope: AccountLease subject, vault, generation and generationId; backend profile binding remains authority
surfaces.storage: generation-scoped UserDefaults envelope plus AccountLease-bound Timer
surfaces.readers: Voice settings, Echo role voice selection, TTS synthesis
surfaces.cleanup: cancel poll, stop profile use, clear cache, and invoke backend rights flow on delete
surfaces.migration: legacy global keys are quarantined as unverified owner evidence and never auto-claimed; rebuild from backend owner/persona profile
surfaces.retention: backend profile lifecycle; local status is rebuildable cache

surfaces.dataClass: generated memoir or TTS audio plus viseme timeline metadata and playback timer
surfaces.ownerScope: AccountLease subject, vault, generation and generationId plus hashed memoir id
surfaces.storage: generation-scoped Application Support files and ephemeral playback timer
surfaces.cleanup: stop playback on switch and purge audio without complete owner/profile binding
surfaces.migration: move legacy global cache to quarantine without owner attribution; regenerate from authoritative text when allowed
surfaces.retention: bounded generated cache

surfaces.dataClass: selected persona context, provider session lease, audio owner, work items, and metering probe
surfaces.ownerScope: context envelope is bound to AccountLease subject, generation and generationId; runtime is bound to the same lease and selected persona
surfaces.storage: generation-scoped UserDefaults envelope plus ephemeral provider runtime/timers/temp file
surfaces.readers: Echo UI, Knowledge persona context, Archive visibility
surfaces.cleanup: close runtime/lease, cancel work items, stop audio, and remove temp probe on lifecycle boundary
surfaces.migration: quarantine subject-only legacy context without auto-claim; never migrate provider session; restore only a currently authorized scoped selection
surfaces.retention: persona selection until revoked; provider runtime process/session only

surfaces.dataClass: family relationship projection, persona/voice overrides, authorization freshness, and care signal message
surfaces.ownerScope: relationship owner plus accepted member/grant; care key is owner-suffixed
surfaces.storage: owner-suffixed standard UserDefaults plus in-memory authorization projection
surfaces.readers: Family UI, Digital Human context, Echo role selection, message center
surfaces.cleanup: unmount and cancel callback on switch; clear projection on revoke/delete
surfaces.migration: pending/failed relationship is not authority; viewer/grant mismatch is discarded
surfaces.retention: rebuildable backend projection

surfaces.dataClass: value-minimized Echo traces, runtime diagnostics, evidence packages, bundles, and exported receipts
surfaces.ownerScope: hashed active owner digest plus validated record owner
surfaces.storage: owner-suffixed standard UserDefaults and owner-digest export directories
surfaces.readers: QA evidence panel and export flow
surfaces.cleanup: remove owner records, manifests, and exports on switch/logout/delete
surfaces.migration: purge legacy global trace keys and temp exports; never infer owner
surfaces.retention: bounded recent records and QA-only exported files

surfaces.dataClass: release policy, recovery runtime policy, runtime capability, and QA feature override
surfaces.ownerScope: policy scope includes subject/cohort/build; feature override is global QA-only
surfaces.storage: standard UserDefaults
surfaces.cleanup: invalidate on TTL, subject/cohort/build, authority epoch, or stricter local fallback
surfaces.migration: do not promote QA global override to production policy
surfaces.retention: policy TTL; QA override until schema reset

surfaces.dataClass: minimal knowledge widget projection and active owner digest
surfaces.ownerScope: active verified owner digest with snapshot owner match
surfaces.storage: App Group file plus suite UserDefaults
surfaces.cleanup: write empty/remove snapshot and reload widget timeline on switch/logout/delete
surfaces.migration: remove legacy global schema rather than assign it to current user
surfaces.retention: latest minimal authorized projection only

surfaces.dataClass: APNs device token, backend registration, owner-targeted local notification requests, and authorization state
surfaces.ownerScope: device token plus currently verified session owner and resource id
surfaces.storage: standard UserDefaults, backend subscription, and UNUserNotificationCenter
surfaces.readers: push registration flow and local reminder delivery
surfaces.cleanup: unregister owner binding and cancel owner/resource notification IDs on switch/logout/delete
surfaces.migration: re-register token only with current verified session; never reuse previous owner binding
surfaces.retention: device registration until token change or lifecycle cleanup; notifications until delivery/cancel

surfaces.dataClass: full private knowledge JSON and family-book PDF exports
surfaces.ownerScope: current graph snapshot only; filenames are not owner authority
surfaces.storage: OS temporary directory and external share destinations
surfaces.cleanup: current implementation has no deterministic post-share removal; WI-S0-01-08 owns cleanup
surfaces.migration: never import or auto-claim a prior temporary export as current owner state
surfaces.retention: currently OS-temporary lifetime; target delete after share completion or cancellation

surfaces.dataClass: Echo transcript-derived delayed reply and push job metadata
surfaces.ownerScope: captured backend subject/resource; client generation is not yet part of cancellation
surfaces.storage: backend job and APNs delivery state
surfaces.cleanup: current client has no account-lifecycle cancel command; WI-S0-01-08 owns fencing/cancel policy
surfaces.migration: do not deliver a prior owner's job into a newly activated account
surfaces.retention: backend delivery lifecycle; bounded policy must be verified in WI-S0-01-08

surfaces.dataClass: synthesized cloned-voice preview audio
surfaces.ownerScope: voiceProfileId only; target requires active owner/profile lease
surfaces.storage: OS temporary file
surfaces.cleanup: current implementation does not deterministically delete after playback; WI-S0-01-07 owns cleanup
surfaces.migration: preview files are never user data authority and must not be mounted after account switch
surfaces.retention: currently OS-temporary lifetime; target playback/session lifetime

surfaces.dataClass: speaker/profile id, persona target, completion closures, and training state
surfaces.ownerScope: captured target without a unified AccountLease checkpoint
surfaces.storage: process memory and repeating Timer
surfaces.readers: VoiceCloneService status callbacks and profile UI
surfaces.cleanup: current success/failure/timeout cancellation exists; account switch cancellation is pending
surfaces.migration: runtime is never migrated; stale callback must be rejected by generation
surfaces.retention: up to provider poll limit or singleton lifetime

surfaces.dataClass: consented voice sample, provider training artifact, profile state, and synthesis authority
surfaces.ownerScope: backend subject plus persona target and voiceProfileId
surfaces.storage: DreamJourney backend and voice provider
surfaces.readers: profile status, synthesis, disable, and delete APIs
surfaces.cleanup: explicit backend disable/delete; account deletion retention receipt remains a downstream obligation
surfaces.migration: never move a provider artifact between subjects or personas
surfaces.retention: backend/provider policy owned by voice-profile rights flow

surfaces.dataClass: pending and last reply text, request ids, turn ids, and conversation state
surfaces.ownerScope: currently controller lifecycle; target account generation plus persona lease
surfaces.storage: process memory
surfaces.cleanup: reset/release exists; unified account lifecycle checkpoint remains pending
surfaces.migration: never migrate conversation runtime across owner/persona selection
surfaces.retention: single Echo view/turn lifetime

surfaces.dataClass: prompt, archive context, chat buffer, ASR text, and SDK event payload
surfaces.ownerScope: currently singleton/process state; target active AccountLease
surfaces.storage: process memory and debug log sink
surfaces.cleanup: partial stop/reset exists; account lifecycle purge and log minimization remain pending
surfaces.migration: never carry prompt/chat buffer into another account generation
surfaces.retention: current process lifetime; target active dialog session only

surfaces.dataClass: remote audio user ids, raw SEI/WebSocket events, and provider session state
surfaces.ownerScope: provider session only; target account/persona lease
surfaces.storage: process memory and provider SDK logging
surfaces.cleanup: bridge close clears runtime; log value minimization remains pending
surfaces.migration: never reuse provider bridge state across account/persona switch
surfaces.retention: provider session lifetime plus external SDK log policy

surfaces.dataClass: provider session/lease plus persona, asset, device, and lifecycle identifiers
surfaces.ownerScope: captured account and selected persona with current lifecycle token
surfaces.storage: backend/provider lease state
surfaces.readers: TencentDigitalHuman runtime and backend lease coordinator
surfaces.cleanup: normal/stale release and server expiry exist; account-switch receipt is verified downstream
surfaces.migration: provider sessions are never migrated or reused
surfaces.retention: server lease TTL or explicit release

surfaces.dataClass: QA-only Echo, provider, digital-human, voice-profile, and smoke result metadata
surfaces.ownerScope: mixed legacy QA artifacts; owner-scoped export store exists but Documents copies remain
surfaces.storage: Documents JSON files and copied QA export files
surfaces.writer: AppDelegate UIQA harness and EchoViewController QA export
surfaces.cleanup: current overwrite-only behavior is insufficient; WI-S0-01-08 owns deterministic purge
surfaces.migration: QA evidence is never production authority and legacy ownerless files are deleted

surfaces.dataClass: value-bearing prompt, ASR, archive, request, session, profile, and provider event diagnostics
surfaces.ownerScope: not consistently owner-scoped; production logs must be value-minimized
surfaces.storage: console, DDLog, OS log, and provider SDK log sinks
surfaces.pathOrKey: DialogEngineManager, Echo diagnostics, and Tencent bridge log calls
surfaces.writer: dialog, Echo, backend client, and provider bridge diagnostics
surfaces.cleanup: current app cannot guarantee external sink purge; WI-S0-01-08 owns minimization and retention contract
surfaces.migration: never treat logs as memory/persona authority
